Indians in Pakistani jails
*401. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Indian civil prisoners
and fishermen in Pakistani jails, at present;
(b) the number of Pakistani prisoners
and fishermen in Indian jails, at present;
(c) the steps being taken to get them
released from the respective countries;
(d) whether Pakistan has given any
assurance in this regard; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
I.T.Is in Assam
†*402. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
LABOUR be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Industrial Training
Institutes in the country, State-wise,
particularly in the State of Assam;
(b) whether Government propose to
open some new Industrial Training
Institutes in Assam;
(c) if so, the details of funds allocated
for the purpose and the names of the places
where these institutes are proposed to be
opened; and
(d) the names of places where Industrial
Training Institutes are proposed to be
opened during the next three years?
I.T. business
†*403. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that business of
information technology industry is
expected to be Rs. 1,96,105 crores by the
year 2006;
(b) if not, the assessments made in this
regard;
(c) whether the share of States has also
been assessed in this business; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, State-wise?
Funds allocated under PMRY in
Karnataka
*404. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the funds allocated to Karnataka

State under the Pradhan Mantri Rozgar
Yojana for the year 1999-2000 onwards,
year-wise;
(b) the amount utilised and unutilised
out of the above allocations; and
(c) the reasons of non-utilisation of the
funds?
Joint working groups on terrorism
*405. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and Russia have set
up joint working groups on terrorism; and
(b) if so, the salient features thereof?
New services by private cell
phone operators
*406. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
PROF. SAIF-UD-DIN SOZ:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the new services recently introduced by
private cell phone operators like Airtel,
Hutch, etc. and whether these are causing
inconvenience to cell phone users;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether these are in accordance with
approval from TRAI; and
(d) if not, what action Government are
willing to take to curb such practices by
private operators?
Creation of jobs for J & K
*407. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of LABOUR be pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken for achieving the goal
set for creating 1.5 lakh jobs in two years
for Jammu and Kashmir;
(b) whether any task force has been set
up to oversee the work; and
(c) what is the present status on the
employment generation front?
Village Public Telephones
*408. SHRIMATI SHABANA
AZMI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Comptroller & Auditor
General of India has pulled up the
Department of Telecommunications for
allowing a benefit of Rs. 812 crores to the
private sector basic service operators
inspite of their failure to install village public
telephones;
(b) if so, whether this has resulted in a
loss of Rs. 720 crores;
(c) if so, how many companies have
failed in implementing the decision; and
(d) the steps being taken to provide
rural phones to the people during the
year 2003?
Vacant posts in North-Eastern
Council
*409. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether several key posts in the
North Eastern Council have remained
vacant for long, causing serious problems
in the Council's functioning;

and

fixed during the past five years were
achieved?

Strength of CBI
3008. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the total officer strength of the CBI
as on 1st April, 2003;
(b) the total strength of supporting
staff;
(c) the number of cases under
investigation as on 1st April, 2002;
(d) the number of additional cases taken
up during the year 2002-03;
(e) the number of cases dropped during
the year 2002-03;
(f) the number of cases on trial as on
1st April, 2003;
(g) the number of cases decided during
the year 2002-03; and
(h) the number of fresh cases pushed
for trial during the year?
Educated unemployed youth in Assam
3009. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES  be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of the educated
unemployed youth in the State of Assam
who applied for loan under the Pradhan
Mantri Rozgar Yojana for setting up their
own industrial units/business since the year
1999-2000, till date;
(b) the details thereof;
(c) the number of applications pending
for approval; and
(d) the reasons for the delay and the
steps taken by Government or proposed
to be taken for their speedy disposal?
Sanction of loans under PMRY
3010. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES  be pleased to state:
(a) the number of cases under Pradhan
Mantri Rozgar Yojana (PMRY) that have
been recommended for sanction of loan by
the Central Government in the year
2002-03, State-wise;
(b) how many of these have been
processed by the banks, State-wise;
(c) in how many of these cases loans
have been provided in full in practice; and
(d) the reasons why these figures differ
between the number sanctioned and the
number actually disbursed?

Decline in growth of cottage
industries
3011. SHRI R. KAMARAJ: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
decline in the growth of cottage industries
in our country;
(b) if so, whether Government have
analysed the factors for such decline in
cottage industries;
(c) the steps being taken by
Government to boost cottage industries
specifically in remote villages to
provide more employment opportunities;
and
(d) the funds allocated for the
development and establishment of cottage
industries during the Tenth Plan period,
State-wise?
Agro-based foreign industries
†3012. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES  be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of agro-based foreign
industries in the country, State-wise;
(b) the details of the proposals received
for setting up of agro-based
industries during the last three years, State-
wise;
(c) the details of proposals approved
till date, State-wise; and
(d) the measures being taken to explore
possibilities of new areas in agro-based
industries?
Special Component Plan of KVIC
†3013. SHRI ABHAY KANT
PRASAD: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES  be pleased
to state:
(a) the norms for selection of various
districts by Khadi and Village Industries
Commission under its Special Component
Plan; and
(b) the names of the districts selected
under the plan particularly in the State of
Jharkhand?
Rural employment in Karnataka
3014. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
implement programme for creating rural
employment in the State of Karnataka;
(b) if so, the achievements made in the
State under this programme during the
Ninth Five Year Plan period alongwith the
amount spent; and
(c) the arrangement made during the
Tenth Five Year Plan period for this State?

(a) whether Government have
formulated any action plan to promote
setting up of agro-based industries in the
rural areas of different States;
(b) if so, the outline thereof and since
when it has been initiated;
